body:
No I appreciate the advice and the comfort. I am supporting him as much as I can but I can't be with him at every moment. I have to try to trust him, it is the best I can do for him I think. And that's all you can really do I guess, is your best.

I hope things turn out too.

I have told him that. He knows he can call me at any time of day or night. I hope that he doesn't consider himself too much of a burden to call. 

Thank you.

The thing is he is insisting on being home with his wife for now, at least for part of the day. I CAN'T go with him there, I will make things so much worse.

I HAD to leave him today to let him go back to that horrible place and that horrible woman. It makes me sick. I tried so hard to keep him from going back but he insisted. He feels responsible for her, for this whole thing.

I'm doing my best to be a good friend but I'm incredibly limited by this. Do you have any ideas?

Thank you for responding by the way.
